model.note: 14684 games over 4 season(s); closing lines; nothing is fitted, the app only looks up how each signal's bucket did

ats_gap.about: The gap between the two teams' average tiers; the history decides whether to back or fade the team that has covered more.
ats_gap.label: Against-the-spread streak (green plus / red minus)

avgs_line.about: The teams' scoring margins say one side should be favoured by more than the line does.
avgs_line.label: Averages vs the spread

total_gap.about: Each side's scoring and the other's points allowed, against the line: Over when it is higher, Under when lower.
total_gap.label: Total vs the teams' scoring

your_rule.about: The team that scores more per game and has covered more, backed.
your_rule.label: Your rule: ahead on scoring AND on covering
